title: fix(plugin-list): offer the In a queue toggle only when the organization has a queue
body:
Fixes #28428

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表工具栏的「在队列中」开关现在只在两个条件都成立时出现:对象带平台注入的 `queue` 字段,且当前会话的 `/auth/me/permissions` 回答 `hasAnyQueue: true`(组织至少有一个队列)。`@object-ui/permissions` 的上下文新增一个可选成员 `hasAnyQueue`,把服务端这个布尔值原样传下去。
- 为什么改:平台给每个归属用户的对象都注入 `queue` 字段,所以没有任何队列的组织(如 app-crm、HotCRM)每个列表都显示这个开关,点了永远是空列表。按 #28428 的裁定 A,服务端已在 #28508 提供该布尔值。
- 风险与回滚:会话没有这个答案时(没有权限提供者、基于角色的提供者、匿名会话)开关隐藏;控制台的提供者在答案到达前不渲染列表,所以控制台里不会出现"加载中"的状态。服务端的队列行为(认领、释放、读取规则)不变。回滚即还原本 PR,无数据或协议变更。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`(`queueFilterOffered`)、`ui/packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx`(`hasAnyQueue`)、`ui/packages/permissions/src/PermissionContext.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.queueSittingFilter-25769.test.tsx packages/permissions/src/__tests__/hasAnyQueue-28428.test.tsx`,预期 18 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/permissions`:** `PermissionContextValue` gains one optional member, `hasAnyQueue?: boolean`. `MePermissionsProvider` sets it from the authenticated `/auth/me/permissions` answer (#28508). It is `undefined` with no answer: the anonymous answer, the role-based `PermissionProvider`, and no provider at all (`usePermissions`' no-provider literal). `ServerReadScope` and `RecordFieldAccessScope` spread their parent, so they forward it unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list`:** `queueFilterOffered` is now `hasAnyQueue === true && objectHasOwnershipQueue(objectDef)`. The flag rides the permissions answer the console already holds, so opening a list reads no queue list and sends no new request.
- **Unknown flag = hidden** (claim amendment 6567840348). Under the console, `MePermissionsProvider` renders its loading fallback until the payload arrives, so a list never sees a pending flag there. Elsewhere (no provider, the role-based provider, an anonymous session) nothing can show a queue exists, so the toggle stays hidden.
- Turning the toggle on filters exactly as before. Nothing on the server changes.

## Why

Route A ruling 6553134732 on #28428: offer the toggle when the object carries the `queue` field AND the session's has-queues boolean is true. In an organization with no queue, the toggle could only return an empty list.

## Tests

- `ListView.queueSittingFilter-25769.test.tsx`: the existing cases now mount under a session double (`MePermissionsProvider` with `hasAnyQueue: true`) and still pass. New cases: no queue gives no toggle even on an object with the injected column; one queue gives the toggle; an unknown answer (no provider, anonymous) gives no toggle; a list mount makes the same data-source calls with and without a queue, every `find` targets the listed object, and `fetch` is never called.
- New `hasAnyQueue-28428.test.tsx` in `@object-ui/permissions`: the truth table (served `true` and `false`, anonymous, forwarded through `ServerReadScope`, role-based provider, no provider).
- Ablations, each run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the blob restored to HEAD afterwards:
  - Gate removed (`(hasAnyQueue === true || true) && …`): 2 red, "no queue" and "unknown answer".
  - Provider member removed (`hasAnyQueue: undefined`): 3 red, served `true`, served `false`, scope forwarding.

## Acceptance notes

Measured on a production console build (`turbo run build`, `pnpm console:build`), `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`, admin, at head `c0b35cd6`:

| State | `/auth/me/permissions` `hasAnyQueue` | `crm_account` list | `crm_contact` list |
|---|---|---|---|
| app-crm as shipped (no queue) | `false` | no toggle | no toggle |
| one `sys_queue` row inserted (201) | `true` | toggle shown | toggle shown |
| row deleted again | `false` | no toggle | no toggle |

- `crm_account` serves the injected `queue` column (`system: true`, hidden), so the old rule would have shown the toggle there.
- Pressing the toggle with one queue sends `GET /api/v1/data/crm_account?…&filter=["and",["owner_id","is_empty",true],["queue","is_not_empty",true]]`, the same filter as before.
- Network: a list load made 31 or 32 API requests in both states, over two runs each. The distinct endpoint sets were identical. The one-request difference is a `sys_user_preference` PATCH that comes and goes with timing in either state. No request in any run named a queue.
- Acceptance 1 says HotCRM too. HotCRM declares no queue (card reading), so it gets `hasAnyQueue: false` and the same result. It was not run here: it lives in another repository.
- Screenshots are in the project files under `issue-28428/`.
